svg.text: PolyStats — database schema, queries & data flow
Cloudflare Worker · D1 (SQLite) · R2 object storage — generated from the live worker source, not from memory
EVERY DB ROUTE CALLS ensureSchema(db) FIRST
· FTS rebuild: INSERT INTO users_fts SELECT … FROM users
· catalog fold: INSERT INTO users SELECT … FROM catalog
kept in sync on every upsert
BACKGROUND WRITES — what the crons do
→ wr_history only when a record falls
ensureSchema() gates every DB route → runs on EVERY cold isolate.
Its migrations were flagged only on SUCCESS, so a failure left the flag unset
and the next isolate rebuilt the FTS index by reading all ~9,700 users rows.
~515 cold starts exhausted the 5,000,000 read/day budget — and past that the
rebuild could never succeed, so it retried forever. Self-sustaining loop.
Symptom: autocomplete dead (503), crons unable to write. Static site fine.
· a failed migration records 'failed' → attempted once, not once per isolate
· the FTS fill checks whether the index already has rows before reading users
· search falls back to LIKE when FTS is not ready (never blocks the route)
~400,000 cold starts/day now needed to exhaust the budget.
Gold = primary key · Blue = foreign-key-ish reference · dashed purple = cron writes · dashed red = schema guard
